description: email.rs handle_email_copy: RFC 8620 §5.4 states 'accountId: The id of the account to copy records to. This MUST be different to the fromAccountId.' The handler does not validate that fromAccountId != accountId. When a client submits fromAccountId == accountId, the handler proceeds and makes copy_email calls with identical source and destination accounts, which could produce undefined behavior or allow self-copies. Should return invalidArguments before any state operations.
title: Email/copy missing validation: accountId MUST differ from fromAccountId
